description.en: The ID of the instance. You can call the GetLindormV2InstanceList operation to obtain the instance ID.

description.zh: 实例所属的地域ID，可调用[DescribeRegions](~~426062~~)接口获取。
description.en: The ID of the region where the instance is located. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~426062~~) operation to obtain this ID.
The list of IP whitelist groups.
The name of the IP whitelist group.

description.zh:
需要设置的白名单IP地址。
> 127.0.0.1表示禁止所有地址访问，例如192.168.0.0/24表示允许所有192.168.0.X的IP地址访问该Lindorm实例。多个白名单用半角逗号（,）分隔。
description.en:
The IP addresses to add to the IP whitelist.

> The value 127.0.0.1 denies access from all IP addresses. For example, 192.168.0.0/24 allows all IP addresses in that range to access the Lindorm instance. Use a comma (,) to separate multiple IP addresses or CIDR blocks.

title.zh: 设置LindormV2实例的访问白名单

example.unifiedCli: aliyun hitsdb update-lindorm-v2-white-ip-list --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id ld-2ze5ipz9zx1e40000 --white-ip-group-list GroupName=user001 WhiteIpList=192.168.0.X/24 --api-version 2020-06-15 --region cn-hangzhou
